notes.title: Halloween update!
notes.notes:
Hello all, 


Halloween has arrived in Deadbeat Heroes and Captain Justice has been hoarding pumpkins again...

[h1]A few things we've added into this update is: [/h1]
[list]
[*]Captain Justice seems to have a Pumpkin farm, there's Pumpkins everywhere in the Cave.
[*]The Deadbeat have bought themselves a Cauldron for the hub...we wonder what they're brewing?
[*]The Prime Sinister has called in the Franken-Goons to take out our charming heroes!
[/list]

The update is live now, so head straight into the game and get spoopy! 

-Amy

notes.title: Deadbeat Heroes - Patch 1.1.0 notes
notes.notes:
Hello to all the heroes out there! 

We have released a significant update addressing numerous aspects of the game flow, this is based on the feedback you've been giving us since launch, please find the patch notes below.

[h1]Feature Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Hub - The Hub (or Justice Cave) is now redesigned to streamline later game navigation from level to level.
[*]Progress is never cleared - Failing a level no longer removes a previous level's ranking.
[*]No more Lives - To compliment the above, new heroes no longer provide additional lives as the concept in this implementation is no longer needed.
[*]Skippable Introduction - The Gym portion of the game can be bypassed if you want to get stuck straight into the main game.
[*]Tighter controls - Tuned the controls for immediately after dashing on the ground so that you can more easily steer.
[/list]
 
As usual thank you so much for your constant support and we are always listening to your feedback, now go be a hero and punch some goons! 


-Amy
